from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
code = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                cells = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    cells.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(cells) < 2:
                    continue
                for er, ec, vr, vc in ((cells[0][0], cells[0][1], -dr, -dc), (cells[-1][0], cells[-1][1], dr, dc)):
                    rr, cc = er + vr, ec + vc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += vr
                        cc += vc
    return out
'''
exec(code)
def sparse(h,w,bg,cells):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (r,c),v in cells.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
